name: gram-setu
description: Gram Setu - AI-Powered Digital Panchayat App for Villagers & Senior Citizens

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client && npx prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npx tsx server/prisma/seed.ts
